name: How Not to Become a Queen
source:
The King is dead. Long live the new King.

The whole kingdom is abuzz in anticipation. With a new ruler ascending the throne and no future spouse in sight, the main aristocratic houses are ready for a bloody battle. Unmarried ladies have already been called to court, armoured with silk, gossip and daggers.

All is fair in love and war, after all.

Play their game, but never forget: to win the game you must not win the crown.

[from [url=https://danapenguin.itch.io/how-not-to-become-a-queen]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
国王死了。新国王万岁。

整个王国都充满了期待。随着新统治者登上王位，而且未来的配偶还看不到，主要贵族家族已经准备好进行一场血腥的战斗。未婚女士们已经被传唤到宫廷，她们身披丝绸、八卦和匕首。

毕竟，爱情和战争都是公平的。

玩他们的游戏，但永远不要忘记：要赢得比赛，你不能赢得皇冠。

[来自[url=https://danapenguin.itch.io/how-not-to-become-a-queen]itch.io[/url]]
